# Estora — Full Platform Documentation

Estora is a modern web application facilitating luxury property discovery, AI-powered semantic search, property comparison, and lead generation.

## System Architecture
- Frontend: React 19 with Vite
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 & Framer Motion
- Database: Google Cloud Firestore (NoSQL)
- Authentication: Firebase Authentication
- AI Engine: Google Gemini API via Vercel Edge Serverless Functions
- Deployment: Vercel Edge Network

## Endpoints and Pages
- /: Main Discover portal with AI Semantic Search and property filtering
- /properties: Full property directory
- /projects: Architectural developments
- /agents: Verified agency partners
- /services: Real estate consultation & mortgage estimation
- /about: Company background
- /contact: Inquiry dispatch
